fact: The DHIS2 for Education report says the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education has published education data in its Statistical Yearbook since 2014, compiled from questionnaires collected at schools each November and published the following May, and refers to the 2026 Statistical Yearbook.
The report says the Statistical Yearbook is compiled from questionnaires collected at schools.
The report says the ministry has published the yearbook annually since 2014 and its minister wrote a preface to the 2026 edition.

The Gambia Bureau of Statistics published its Transport Statistics 2025 Summary Report in June 2026, covering 2021-2025 and compiled from administrative data obtained from GCAA, GPA, the Gambia Police Force and GFSC.

GBoS says the report is compiled from administrative data: air traffic from the Gambia Civil Aviation Authority, sea transport from the Gambia Ports Authority, ferry crossings from the Gambia Ferry Service Company, and road accidents and registered vehicles from the Gambia Police Force.
The report gives five-year series 2021-2025 of air traffic at Banjul airport, ferry passenger crossings, and police-recorded road accident cases (1,001 in 2025, 837 in 2024), per GBoS.
